text: {"label":"Memory, Remembering, and Forgetting","definition":"Behavioral, comparative, and neuro-operant analyses of memory: recall, recognition, memory span, forgetting functions, and animal list memory, plus related cognition, aging and dementia, and memory rehabilitation.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on remembering and forgetting as the subject, not general operant organization and stability, stimulus equivalence class formation itself, or competing stimulus assessments for applied problem behavior."}
